description: Get live Amazon product data by ASIN: title, brand, price, list price, stock, rating, review count, images and feature bullets as JSON. No API key needed. Use it when: You need the current price, availability or specs of one product on Amazon.com. Not for: Searching across many products, or placing an order. Returns: Title, brand, price, list price, in-stock status, rating, review count, images, feature bullets and product details. Typical time: about 10 s. Price: $0.007 per product, charged only on success. One call = data for one product.

asin.description: The 10-character Amazon product ID (ASIN), e.g. B0BSHF7WHW
